retrievedSource.rawText:
“ Excluded Revolving Loans ” means as of any date of determination (i) [reserved], (ii) the
aggregate principal amount of any revolving loans (including any ABL Loans) incurred after the Effective Date to fund working capital and (iii) the aggregate principal amount of any revolving loans (including any ABL Loans) that are incurred
substantially concurrently or, if not substantially concurrently, such incurrences or transactions are related to a series of transactions (as determined by the Initial Borrower in good faith) with the transaction for which such determination is
being made.

“ Test Period ”
means, at any date of determination, (a) the period of four (4) consecutive fiscal quarters of the Initial Borrower or (b) twelve (12)-month period, in the case of clauses (a) and (b), then most recently ended on or prior to such
time (taken as one (1) accounting period), in respect of which financial statements are, at the election of the Initial Borrower, (x) internally available (and to the extent requested by the Administrative Agent, delivered to the
Administrative Agent) or (y) have been delivered pursuant to Section 5.01(a) or Section 5.01(b) .

overallNotes: Source is a Section 1.01 defined-terms alphabetical run (Inside Maturity Basket through Junior Lien Priority); every distinct defined term in the supplied text was extracted as its own WireDefinition, consistent with the multiple-definitions requirement - none were dropped even where non-computational.

No independently operative WireRule was emitted: nothing in this text grants/restricts a transaction directly (Inside Maturity Basket defines a basket AMOUNT but the permission to incur under it, if any, lives in a separate covenant section such as Section 6.01 not included in this submission).

Section 1.08(f) (cross-referenced by the 'Investments' Fixed Amount-basket disposition proviso) was directly retrieved via getReferencedProvision and confirmed to resolve to blank/empty text in the available source - this is a genuine source gap, not an unattempted lookup.

'Fixed Amount' is used in the 'Investments' definition but has no detected definition anywhere in the document package (already flagged by Phase 2); the corresponding proviso is dispositioned as its own MISSING_CONTEXT sub-definition (d10x) rather than silently dropped or force-fit.

'Excluded Revolving Loans' and 'Test Period', both needed to give the Interest Coverage Ratio's exclusion and period scoping their real meaning, were resolved via getDefinition and are reflected in the Interest Coverage Ratio calculationExpression and dependsOnTerms.

Several definitions (Intellectual Property, Interest Election Request, ISDA CDS Definitions, Judgment Currency) are pure pointer definitions to other sections/agreements; because the definition's own operative content IS the pointer, these are marked COMPLETE without needing the target section's substantive text, consistent with only fetching evidence needed to resolve THIS provision's own economics.
